takes.title: Mime Repeated Strikes and Return to Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing, brings the hands up, and repeats short arm extensions with turns and brief knee bends. The arms lower as the performer settles upright.

takes.title: Mime Swordplay with Wide Arm Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands close to the chest, then rotates while sweeping the arms across the body, reaching forward and lifting the hands near the head. The motion finishes with the hands drawn back in front of the chest.

takes.title: Mime Swordplay with High Arm Arcs
takes.actionDescription: From upright, the performer repeatedly turns and brings both hands up beside the head, alternating with forward arm extensions and brief knee bends. They finish standing with the hands held close together.

takes.title: Mime Swordplay with Deep Knee Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands together, turns into several short side-facing arm sweeps, and bends the knees progressively deeper. They rise and finish facing forward with the hands gathered in front.

takes.title: Mime Washing the Face and Upper Body
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly bends to reach toward the floor, then rises to bring a hand to the face, head, neck, and shoulders. They lower the arms and finish standing still.
